'''Lya Charrel''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] scientist living during the [[Galactic War]]. She defected from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], finding its methods much more to her liking.
While stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], she asked an Imperial to spill the canisters of dangerous [[3-5-7 trichloroheptane]] stored in the [[Taris ChemWorks Factory]].<ref name="TOR" />
